# freeprompttester.app

> Free, browser-based AI prompt tester. Two modes: (1) Single-shot — run the same prompt across up to 6 models in parallel and optionally merge responses with ✦ Synthesize. (2) Chat — hold a parallel multi-turn conversation with up to 3 models, each maintaining its own history. Supports 25+ curated models across 8 providers via direct browser calls plus the entire OpenRouter live catalog (370+ models). Static page, no proxy, keys never leave the browser.

## Key facts

- Two modes: single-shot multi-model comparison, and multi-turn parallel chat
- ✦ Synthesize: merge completed responses into one answer with consensus + disagreement sections
- Runs entirely client-side (static HTML/CSS/JS). No Freesuite servers in the request path.
- Bring-your-own-key: paste a key per provider; stored in browser localStorage only.
- 8 providers via direct browser CORS: Anthropic, Google AI, xAI, Mistral, DeepSeek, Groq, Cohere, OpenRouter
- OpenRouter is the recommended path for OpenAI models because the OpenAI API blocks direct browser calls
- OpenRouter tab exposes the full live catalog (370+ models) with a provider sub-filter and search
- Streamed responses with TTFT (time-to-first-token), total latency, input/output token counts, per-call cost
- Cost is computed from each provider's reported usage × published per-million rates
- Per-card actions: copy, regenerate, stop, pin
- Reasoning models (GPT-5, o-series, DeepSeek R1) auto-clamp temperature to 1
- Chat mode: max 3 models per conversation; cap chosen because input cost grows quadratically with turns
- Soft cap of 6 models per single-shot run
- localStorage persistence for prompt, chat history, system prompt, params, theme, model selection, API keys
- Works offline as a PWA shell (provider calls obviously still need network)
- No analytics on input. No third-party SDKs. No tracking cookies.
- Free, no sign-up.

## Curated models (direct browser API calls)

- Anthropic: Claude Opus 4.7, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5
- Google: Gemini 2.5 Pro, 2.5 Flash, 2.0 Flash
- xAI: Grok 4, Grok 4 Fast, Grok 3
- Mistral: Large 2, Medium 3, Small 3.1
- DeepSeek: V3.1, R1
- Groq (Llama): Llama 4 Scout 17B, Llama 3.3 70B, Llama 3.1 8B
- Cohere: Command A, Command R+, Command R

## OpenRouter (live catalog, single key for OpenAI + 370+ models)

The OpenRouter tab fetches the complete model list from OpenRouter's public `/api/v1/models` endpoint at page load and surfaces every model it offers, including:
- All OpenAI models (GPT-5 family, GPT-4.1, o-series)
- Anthropic, Google, Meta/Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI, Cohere, Perplexity, NVIDIA, MiniMax, Qwen, and ~50 other providers
- Sub-filter dropdown groups models by their OpenRouter provider prefix
- Search box matches by display name or canonical id

## Privacy model

freeprompttester.app is a static page. The page sends prompts directly from the user's browser to each AI provider the user selects. No request reaches Freesuite servers. API keys are stored in browser localStorage and used only to authenticate direct provider calls. Chat conversation history is also stored only in localStorage. The user can verify all of this by inspecting the Network tab in their browser's developer tools while running a prompt or chatting.

## Cost model

Each provider returns input and output token counts at the end of a streamed response (or in the `usage` object on a non-streaming response). freeprompttester.app multiplies those counts by the model's published per-million rates to display per-call cost. In single-shot mode, the run bar sums costs across the run. In chat mode, each column shows cumulative cost across all turns (input grows quadratically as history is re-sent each turn). No subscription; all spend is billed by the AI provider directly.
